byteBcdIncrement.contract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510; read $0400 exactly once, add one packed-decimal byte, restore clear D, write $0420 exactly once; no input/output scratch; exclude the same startup return jump on both sides

byteBcdTwoReads.contract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510; read $0400 then $0401 exactly once each, add their packed-decimal bytes, restore clear D, write $0420 exactly once; exclude the same startup return jump on both sides

byteBcdTwoReadsSubtract.contract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510; read $0400 then $0401 exactly once each before decimal-mode and carry setup, subtract their packed-decimal bytes, restore clear D, write $0420 exactly once; exclude the same startup return jump

wordBcdIncrement.contract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510; read $0400 low then $0401 high before either write, add packed-decimal word one with carry into high byte, write $0420 low then $0421 high, leave D clear; exclude common startup return

wordBcdTwoReadsAdd.contract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510; read $0400/$0401 then $0402/$0403 exactly once each in low-high order before decimal-mode and carry setup, add their packed-decimal words, restore clear D, write $0420/$0421 in low-high order; exclude common startup return

wordBcdTwoReadsSubtract.contract: PAL C64 NMOS 6510; read $0400/$0401 then $0402/$0403 exactly once each in low-high order before decimal-mode and carry setup, subtract their packed-decimal words, restore clear D, write $0420/$0421 in low-high order; exclude common startup return

wordBcdDecrement.contract: Same ordered word read/write and D-state contract as wordBcdIncrement, subtracting packed-decimal word one with borrow into high byte
